body:
PR-2768 (https://github.com/joemooney/aida/pull/2768), head 9a0efe103d. Not merged. Security-relevant, so strict review please.
1. PRIORITY: the corpus gate's Ok(None) arm now applies TASK-1960's carry-over via the same review_carryover::prove_for_refusal (quiet site, protected base). It clears only when every live verdict's current recording approves, the corpus approves that older sha, and the proof passes; anything else refuses with the reason. Wired into ship plus the GitHub, GitLab, and pure-git merge_change paths. Tests: clean merge clears; evil merge, hidden commit, changed own diff, a standing refusal, and a non-default base all refuse.
2. Ledger race: append_record is now a single write_all of line+\n. The concurrent test (8×50) fails 3/3 on the old writeln! and passes on the fix.
3a. TASK-1965 done: restored the continuations in proven_base_refusal; no-gap test.
3b. TASK-1966 done in part: mandate_ship_cover(prove_carry_over: bool), true only for ship. The re-check under the merge lease is kept on purpose.
3c. TASK-1964 left for a follow-up: its code (PR-2712, publish_verdict_no_replace) isn't on main yet.
Gates: check-ci-fast (32) ok, check-ci-compile ok, targeted filters green, clippy clean.
subject: TASK-1968 ready for STRICT review: PR-2768 @ 9a0efe103d
